intro: More than 90% of Tajikistan is mountains, including the Pamirs, called the 'Roof of the World'.

chapters.title: Roof of the World
text: The Pamirs rise in the east, with Ismoil Somoni Peak at 7,495 m. The Fedchenko Glacier is one of the longest outside the polar regions.
The Pamir Highway is one of the highest roads in the world.

chapters.title: Rivers and lakes
text: Glaciers feed great rivers like the Panj and Vakhsh. The Rogun Dam, being built on the Vakhsh, will be the tallest dam in the world.

keyTerms.meaning: A slowly moving river of ice.
